about: Acceptance register for PsyAlliance. Each item has a stable ID; tests are matched by the IDs at the start of their titles. Route items are added automatically from routes.json (one per page, every role). Status comes from the runs passed to tools/build-register.mjs.

items.title: Independent runner: sign in, journey, account switch, refresh, new session, evidence
One winner: a client is covered once; a referral has one chosen colleague (sequential, concurrent, duplicate, direct writes, stale accept after cancel)
A message creates the recipient's in-app and held email deliveries, written whole
Unread message email reaches the inbox through the provider; a read one is suppressed
Digest every two weeks saves and survives a reload
The author can mark a reply useful; it saves; the replier can't change it
Back from the referral review keeps the chosen colleagues
A pending member's Home points to the in-product demos
A reset request the mail service refuses or rate-limits is reported honestly; unknown and known addresses get the same answer
Signing up again with a registered email sends the owner an email (without saying the address is registered); a new sign-up's confirmation works
Password reset from the email, sign-in with the new password, link can't be reused
Sign out ends the session
Escape closes a demo even with focus inside it; focus returns to Watch
The sandbox the Demos page points to can be opened
A page change or save that arrives but never shows is completed (watchdog)
items.notes: Diagnostic probe: tests/diagnostics/nav01-stall-probe.spec.ts. Baseline stalls about 1 in 5 sends; candidate 24/24 delivered.

items.title: A save the database refuses shows a plain sentence, keeps what was typed, never the database's wording
Temporary email provider failures are retried (three more tries); refusals fail at once
Pages draw the same on the server and in the browser (no hydration errors)
items.notes: React #418 seen on 3 of 474 page loads in the route sweep (Consult new, Availability, Demos), not reproduced in 15 targeted reloads. Recoverable: React redraws the page. Needs a development build to see the differing text.

items.title: Profile photo import only from public https addresses, images only, 5 MB
items.notes: Host-name checks, no IP literals, redirects re-checked, bytes sniffed. A public name that resolves to a private address is not resolved first; on Cloudflare Workers private addresses aren't reachable, so the residual risk is low.
